bug_semantics: Stored XSS in the bundled cama_contact_form plugin. An authenticated caller POSTs unsanitized HTML in railscf_mail[previous_html] (the editor field labeled 'Code HTML before Form'; the advisory's before_html) to Plugins::CamaContactForm::AdminFormsController#update, which writes params[:railscf_mail] into the form settings JSON with no HTML gate. The public shortcode view app/views/plugins/cama_contact_form/forms_shorcode.html.erb copies that value into before_form and emits it with <%= raw r[:before_form] %>, so a stored <script> (or equivalent) runs in any browser that loads the form. Through Camaleon 2.9.1 the plugin admin controller inherited PluginsAdminController with only cama_authenticate and no authorize! :manage, :plugins, so any logged-in user could reach /admin/plugins/cama_contact_form/admin_forms/:id. Same-origin admin and frontend means the script runs in an administrator session.
flaw_origin: The extracted plugin's 2016-05-18 initial commit (9b3f5462846596b3f0d07dd15940ce4879382e29) already collected previous_html and saved params[:railscf_mail] unsanitized, but the shortcode still set before_form to an empty string, so stored before-HTML could not execute. The next-day single-parent commit 4d9e3ca236737a5afd72e714629370cd86f78dbe ('missing prev and after content for forms') is the first write that assigned @form.the_settings[:railscf_mail][:previous_html] to before_form while leaving <%= raw r[:before_form] %> in place. That is the smallest surviving public commit that created the stored-XSS dataflow. It is a human Owen Peredo commit, not a move, squash, revert, or backport. The bundled contact-form tree in camaleon-cms before extraction (cb8f500efcb6d9038711155b8cb68d12ba097b69^) had neither the previous_html field nor this wiring.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-73332 is a real published stored-XSS, not withdrawn. The unique sink is unsanitized previous_html (advisory before_html) persisted by the contact-form admin update action and emitted through raw in the public shortcode. That dataflow is not in the pre-extraction camaleon bundled plugin; it was written in the extracted cama_contact_form history. The initial plugin commit collected the field but left before_form empty, so it is not the BIC. 4d9e3ca236737a5afd72e714629370cd86f78dbe is the smallest commit that first wrote the wiring of stored previous_html into the existing raw before_form sink; the immediate parent tree was checked and lacks that assignment. AI is judged only on that BIC commit object: human author/committer Owen Peredo, empty trailers, no bot. Later plugin/host remediations (dcc8604, aca0afc, d2bb635, ab240651, 8b33127f) carry Claude Opus 5 co-authorship on several fix commits; AI-only-on-fix does not attribute the introducer. Closed NOT_AI with BIC 4d9e3ca... and host fix merge 8b33127f... (2.9.3), whose direct plugin patch is aca0afc... (0.1.12 reject gate).
